acceptance: The plugin keeps: one buffer per session (term-<name>), display before spawn so the PTY gets the window size, project association, completion over running sessions, and attach-or-create. It loses: session naming, label derivation, its own `zmx list` parser, and the systemd-run launcher - all of which are now the wrapper's job. Callers pass `<project>.<id>`; the wrapper supplies labels and durability. Tests cover what remains; the deleted parser tests go with the code they tested.
body: Vendored from ~/dl-zmx.el as the starting point (dl-zmx-test.el with it). Read e-elisp for what the original established and what it got wrong: `ended` means the last task finished, not that the session died, so the old skip-ended filter dropped live sessions. Also drop its duplication of the naming convention - that duplication is the bug this project exists to remove.
title: Rewrite the Emacs plugin onto the wrapper
